title: assessment.category_assigned payload
description: Payload of the assessment.category_assigned event (assessment-service; docs/architecture.md §3.1 row 4, §4.3; docs/testing_model.md §7.1, §8; docs/backlog/closed_questions.md TD-1). Emitted through the transactional outbox on every completed attempt (including up/down and repeated attempts) with the current category; selection-service consumes it to update the category projection (selection.candidate_categories). θ is deliberately excluded — test results and θ are never revealed to employers (docs/testing_model.md §8).

candidate_id.description: Identifier of the candidate (candidate.profiles.id, logical reference).

specialization_code.description: Specialization taxonomy code; category = specialization × grade (docs/selection.md).

grade.description: Assigned grade from the cut-score band (docs/testing_model.md §6.2).

category_code.description: Assigned category code (specialization × grade), projected into selection.candidate_categories.

session_id.description: Test session that produced the category; null on the manual needs_review path (docs/testing_model.md §6.3, §8).

assigned_at.description: UTC instant the category was assigned (ISO-8601); projection column assigned_at.
